title: Choose RF Orca’s new mark-board world
question: The roll assigned Broadcast Patch Bay. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll — then we build clickable phone / iPad / desktop explorers.

options.label: Broadcast Patch Bay
options.lineage: broadcast / live-sound patch bays — labeled jacks, numbered rows, punch-down clarity
options.thesis: The mark board is a patch field: every channel is a labeled jack, Deploy+Room is the cord you punch.
options.viewport: Phone: dense labeled channel strips with Deploy+Room as the punch action; empty groups gone; Who tucked behind setup.
options.risk: Can feel industrial-cold if labels outrank the Deploy action.

raised.raise: Every control wears a printed label — nothing unlabeled on the floor.
Deployed / Staged / Open are flat ink fields, not muddy washes.

options.label: Flight Deck Gauges
options.lineage: aircraft instrument panel — calm bezels, arcs, status you glance
options.thesis: Airplane-gauge calm: progress and Deploy read as instruments you trust without hunting.
options.viewport: Phone: primary Deploy gauge + room destination; MHz as secondary readout; Who off-stage.
options.risk: Also the direction most runs land on for this brief — familiar, effective.

options.label: Miura Deploy Sheet
options.lineage: Miura-fold deployable sheets — one pull opens the field
options.thesis: Rooms and channels fold compact for setup, then one Deploy pull opens the floor sheet.
options.viewport: Phone: compact packet of staged rooms; Deploy unfolds that room’s gear field.
options.case: Owns product clarity on the word Deploy; weaker floor-crew identification than rack/gauge.
options.risk: Paper-fold grammar can feel too light for house-light floor use.

options.label: Split-Flap Concourse
options.thesis: Channels are departure rows; Deploy flips the destination to the room — every head lifts on the cascade.
options.viewport: Phone: ruled channel rows; Deploy cascades room letters; empty destinations omitted.
options.case: Strong live-board clarity and crew identification; denser than calm gauge.
options.risk: Retro novelty if the grid is not strict.

options.label: Depot Destination Blind
options.lineage: transit destination blinds — cloth courses under one window
options.thesis: Room is the destination legend; Deploy steps the course — a fault stops mid-seam.
options.viewport: Phone: one fixed window of active groups; Deploy snaps a course to the room name.
options.case: Strong Operate grammar for room destination; less MHz/band native than RF gear.
options.risk: Cloth metaphor can fight frequency-board expectations.

options.label: Alphabet Storm
options.case: Loses audience ID and Operate clarity — weather grammar fights floor marking.
options.kept: Snap state changes that leave a readable word throughout.

options.label: WPA Park Poster
options.case: Loses both axes — poster scene, not a mark instrument.
options.kept: Flat ink state planes (raised into Patch Bay).

options.label: Busytown Cutaway
options.case: Loses both axes — toy-town tone wrong for house lights.
options.kept: Relentless printed labels (raised into Patch Bay).

canonCard.label: Dark RF dashboard (category standard)
canonCard.thesis: What RF / AV mark tools usually ship: dark panel, neon accents, dense tables.
canonCard.viewport: Familiar dark dashboard with Deploy and channel list at full craft.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other dark ops tool by design.
